posts.title: The Skills I'm Willing to Let AI Have
posts.description: I have dyslexic tendencies, and LLMs read through my scrambled typing so well that I've stopped fixing it. That's freeing, and it's exactly what worries me.

posts.title: The planet doesn't need more pledges. It needs proof.
posts.description: Recycling rates are flat, sustainability reports are greenwash, and the circular economy keeps failing for one reason: the data doesn't exist. Here is the framework I'm building to fix it.

posts.title: Why Private LLM Apps Matter: The Case Behind Merrin
posts.description: Cloud AI assistants keep a server-side copy of everything you tell them. Here is what the policies actually say, and why open-weight models running on your own device change the equation.
